verdict.rationale: The privacy policy says linking Google Workspace gives Instinct access to Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides. One tester mentions using it while 'working on our data room for LPs', which loosely suggests file work through connected tools. Nothing shows it actually creating or iteratively editing documents or presentations, or producing exportable files. Missing for 10: documented file/document creation, iterative editing workflow, presentation generation, export formats, hands-on corroboration of document authoring.
